findings.issue: Non-404 API failures throw from loaders, but neither the router (app/src/router.tsx:5-11) nor any route defines an errorComponent, so an API hiccup renders TanStack Router's default, unstyled error output with no h1 or page chrome.
findings.suggestion: Set defaultErrorComponent on createRouter (and optionally per-route) with a styled fallback that keeps the banner/main/footer landmarks.

findings.issue: The root head reads match._notFound, a private internal field, alongside the public match.status check, to compute the 'Not found' title.
findings.suggestion: Rely on the public status === 'notFound' signal and the child routes' own head fallbacks, or add a comment pinning the version this workaround targets.

findings.issue: tsconfig has strict: true and noEmit, but no script runs tsc — vite build doesn't typecheck, so the types are never enforced anywhere.
findings.suggestion: Add "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit" and chain it into build (as the framework's own hosting docs do).

findings.issue: The raw (untrimmed) query is written to ?q while matching uses the trimmed value, so padded input matches live but yields 'No Pokémon found' after a reload.
An out-of-range ?page= is clamped for rendering but the URL keeps the bogus value, so the 'Previous page' link and URL disagree with the shown page.
findings.suggestion: Replace the search to the clamped page when requestedPage is out of range.

findings.issue: The size cap only deletes expired entries; under a burst of distinct keys the cache can exceed 5000 until entries age out.
findings.suggestion: Also evict the oldest entries (or use an LRU) when the expiry sweep frees nothing.

findings.issue: Every file under dist/client is served with maxAge=31536000 and immutable; the comment assumes everything is content-hashed, which breaks the day an unhashed public asset (favicon, robots.txt) is added.
findings.suggestion: Restrict the immutable Cache-Control to /assets/ (or to hashed filenames) and serve the rest with a short max-age.

findings.issue: Row key is `${row.move}-${row.level}`, which can collide if the API lists the same move twice for the same version group and learn method.
findings.suggestion: Include the row index (or method) in the key.

findings.issue: getPokemonPage's handler mixes version-group resolution, move-table assembly and summary fetches in one ~55-line function.
findings.suggestion: Extract move-table assembly (vgNames/byMethod/methods) into a helper in pokeapi.ts or a sibling module.

summary: A genuinely idiomatic, well-layered TanStack Start app: routing, loaders, server functions, head, 404s and even the self-hosted srvx server match the framework's current documented patterns, and the team feature is engineered with real care around SSR-correct cookie state. The abstractions are few, well-bounded and consistently commented for why. I'd merge it after a nit round: add an error component, drop the one private-API read, wire up typechecking, and fix a handful of small pagination/cache/cache-header edge cases.
